title: Recurring characters
content: Not exactly “mallworld” although my dreams often have the same settings. I’m wondering what you all think of recurring characters. These are all people I’ve known in real life but usually people I haven’t known for close to 20 years. They often play similar roles but I’d say the same like 10-20 max people are very often in my dreams. Rarely my husband or children are in my dreams or even current friends. Does this happen to you guys too? Why do you think that is?
